name: @kitora/task-list
description: Kitora's headless, adapter-driven task lists: provider, list and kanban boards with drag, filters, saved views, bulk actions and the styled parts.

exports.name: Task
exports.description: One task: id, title, status and optional priority, owner, due date, project, tag, comment count and subtasks.

exports.name: TaskStatus
exports.description: A task's workflow status.

exports.name: TaskPriority
exports.description: A task's priority, from `p0` (urgent) to `p3` (low).

exports.name: TaskListGroup
exports.description: One list on the board: its id, title, tasks, collapsed state and optional pagination.

exports.name: TaskListFeatures
exports.description:
Per-feature toggles. `true` enables the feature when the adapter supports
it. `false` hard-disables (even if the adapter wires it). `undefined` =
default (enabled when the adapter implements the corresponding method).

exports.name: TaskListAdapter
exports.description: The backend contract for the task list: `load` is required, every mutation is optional and its absence hides the matching UI.

exports.name: AdapterCapabilities
exports.description:
Capabilities — which mutations the adapter supports. Computed once when
an adapter is registered; used to derive sensible defaults for the
`features` flags on the provider.

exports.name: MaybePromise
exports.description: A value, or a Promise of it: adapter methods may answer either way.

exports.name: inspectCapabilities
exports.description: Which optional mutations an adapter implements, one boolean per method.

exports.name: createInMemoryAdapter
exports.description: A task-list adapter that keeps every group and task in memory and implements every mutation; for demos, tests and as a template.

exports.name: InMemoryAdapterOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createInMemoryAdapter}: seed groups, simulated latency and page size.

exports.name: TaskListProvider
exports.description: Headless root of the task list: loads groups from the adapter and shares them, the feature flags and optimistic mutators with the connected components below.

props.name: adapter
props.description: The backend the provider loads groups from and sends mutations to.

props.name: features
props.description:
Override or hard-disable individual features. Anything you leave
`undefined` defaults to enabled when the adapter implements the
underlying mutation.

props.name: children
props.description: The connected task-list components that read this provider.

exports.name: useTaskList
exports.description: The nearest {@link TaskListProvider}'s groups, features, capabilities and mutators; throws outside one.

props.name: adapter
props.description: The backend the provider loads groups from and sends mutations to.

props.name: features
props.description:
Override or hard-disable individual features. Anything you leave
`undefined` defaults to enabled when the adapter implements the
underlying mutation.

props.name: children
props.description: The connected task-list components that read this provider.

exports.name: TaskListContextValue
exports.description: What {@link useTaskList} returns: the loaded groups, the loading flag, effective features, adapter capabilities, mutators and `refresh`.

exports.name: ConnectedTaskListBoard
exports.description:
Drop-in `<TaskListBoard>` that wires every prop from the headless
provider. Each handler is only attached when:
  1. the adapter implements the underlying mutation, AND
  2. the user hasn't disabled the feature via `features` on the provider.

props.name: inferStatusFromList
props.description:
Map a moved task to a new status when dropped into a list — typically
for kanban-by-status flows. Default: no-op.

props.name: groups
props.description:
Override which groups to render. Defaults to `useTaskList().groups`.
Pass `useTaskListUI().filteredGroups` to render a filtered view.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the board.

props.name: onTaskMove
props.type: ( taskId: string, sourceGroupId: string, targetGroupId: string, beforeTaskId: string | null, /** Other selected task ids dragged together (excludes the primary). */ additionalTaskIds?: string[], ) => void
props.description:
Granular drag callbacks. When supplied, take precedence over
`onGroupsChange` for that kind of change — letting headless adapters
dispatch a single moveTask / reorderGroups call instead of diffing.

props.name: onListReorder
props.description: Called when the user reorders lists, with every list id in the new order.

props.name: onListDelete
props.description: Called when the user deletes a list, with its id.

props.name: onListCollapse
props.description: Called when the user collapses or expands a list, with its id and the new state.

props.name: onTaskToggle
props.type: (groupId: string, task: Task, next: boolean) => void
props.description: Called when the user checks or unchecks a task, with its list id, the task and the new done state.

props.name: onTaskStatusChange
props.type: (groupId: string, task: Task, status: TaskStatus) => void
props.description: Called when the user picks a status for a task, with its list id, the task and the status.

props.name: onTaskOpen
props.description: Called when the user opens a task, with its list id and the task.

props.name: onAddList
props.description: Called when the user presses the add-list button; the button shows only when this is set.

props.name: onAddTask
props.type: ( groupId: string, title: string, position: 'top' | 'bottom', ) => void
props.description: Called when the user adds a task from a list's composer, with the list id, the title and whether it goes at the `top` or `bottom`; the composers show only when this is set.

props.name: onRenameTask
props.type: (groupId: string, task: Task, newTitle: string) => void
props.description: Called when the user renames a task inline, with its list id, the task and the new title.

props.name: onDuplicateTask
props.description: Called when the user duplicates a task, with its list id and the task; the menu item shows only when this is set.

props.name: onDeleteTask
props.description: Called when the user deletes a task, with its list id and the task; the menu item shows only when this is set.

props.name: onAddSubtask
props.description: Called when the user adds a subtask, with the list id and the parent task; the menu item shows only when this is set.

props.name: onRenameList
props.description: Called when the user renames a list, with its id and the trimmed new title; renaming is offered only when this is set.

props.name: onDuplicateList
props.description: Called when the user duplicates a list, with its id; the menu item shows only when this is set.

props.name: onLoadMoreTasks
props.description:
Per-list pagination — when supplied, "Load more" footer renders
beneath each list whose `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is true.

props.name: pagerSlot
props.description:
Custom per-list pagination footer. When supplied, this slot wins
over the default "Load more" button — render any pager UI you like
(Prev/Next buttons, page-jumper, infinite-scroll hint, etc).
Receives the live group so `pageInfo` / `totalCount` / `loadingMore`
are available.

props.name: taskListVirt
props.type: { containerHeight: number estimateRowHeight?: number overscan?: number }
props.description:
Virtualize each list's row stack via `<TaskList>`'s `virt` prop.
When set, every list gets its own internal virt scroller — same
`<TaskList>` rendering with all features (subtasks, multi-select,
drag-drop, status pickers, inline-add).

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: The ids of tasks whose subtasks are shown.

props.name: onToggleExpand
props.description: Called when the user expands or collapses a task's subtasks, with its id.

exports.name: TaskListUIProvider
exports.description: View state for the task list (search, filters, view mode, selection, expansion, preview, saved views), placed inside a {@link TaskListProvider }.

props.name: savedViewsStorageKey
props.description: Persist saved views in localStorage under this key. Pass `null` to disable persistence.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initial view mode.

props.name: children
props.description: The task-list UI parts (search, filters, views) that share this state.

exports.name: useTaskListUI
exports.description: The nearest {@link TaskListUIProvider}'s view state; throws outside one.

exports.name: useOptionalTaskListUI
exports.description:
Returns the UI context if a provider is mounted, else null. Lets primitive
components opt into shared UI state without requiring it.

props.name: savedViewsStorageKey
props.description: Persist saved views in localStorage under this key. Pass `null` to disable persistence.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initial view mode.

props.name: children
props.description: The task-list UI parts (search, filters, views) that share this state.

exports.name: TaskListUIContextValue
exports.description: What {@link useTaskListUI} returns: search and filters, view mode, selection, expansion, preview, saved views and the filtered groups.

exports.name: TaskListViewMode
exports.description: How the task list is shown: `grouped` (lists board), `flat` (sections) or `kanban`.

exports.name: TaskListFilterChip
exports.description: One active facet filter (`owner` or `project`) and the value it matches.

exports.name: SavedView
exports.description: A named snapshot of the search, status, priority and chip filters that can be re-applied.

exports.name: TaskListStats
exports.description:
Compact KPI strip — Total, Open, Done, Blocked. Plug-in feature; reads
from the providers, no data wiring needed.

props.name: tasks
props.description:
Override which tasks to compute stats from. Defaults to:
- `useTaskListUI().allFilteredTasks` when a UIProvider is mounted, OR
- every task across every list from `useTaskList()`.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the stats strip.

props.name: tasks
props.description:
Override which tasks to compute stats from. Defaults to:
- `useTaskListUI().allFilteredTasks` when a UIProvider is mounted, OR
- every task across every list from `useTaskList()`.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the stats strip.

exports.name: TaskListSearch
exports.description: The search box that filters the task list by title; place it inside a `TaskListUIProvider`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text of the search box.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint shown in the box.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class on the search box's container (its width).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text of the search box.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint shown in the box.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class on the search box's container (its width).

exports.name: TaskListStatusFilter
exports.description: A combobox that sets the task list's status filter; place it inside a `TaskListUIProvider`.

props.name: options
props.description: The statuses to offer; `all` clears the filter.
props.docDefault: [{ value: 'all', label: 'Any status' }, { value: 'todo', label: 'Todo' }, { value: 'doing', label: 'In progress' }, { value: 'review', label: 'In review' }, { value: 'blocked', label: 'Blocked' }, { value: 'done', label: 'Done' }]
props.codeDefault: [{ value: 'all', label: 'Any status' }, { value: 'todo', label: 'Todo' }, { value: 'doing', label: 'In progress' }, { value: 'review', label: 'In review' }, { value: 'blocked', label: 'Blocked' }, { value: 'done', label: 'Done' }]

props.name: triggerWidth
props.description: Tailwind width class of the trigger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the filter; announced before the selected option.

exports.name: TaskListPriorityFilter
exports.description: A combobox that sets the task list's priority filter; place it inside a `TaskListUIProvider`.

props.name: options
props.description: The priorities to offer; `all` clears the filter.
props.docDefault: [{ value: 'all', label: 'Any priority' }, { value: 'p0', label: 'P0', hint: 'urgent' }, { value: 'p1', label: 'P1', hint: 'high' }, { value: 'p2', label: 'P2', hint: 'medium' }, { value: 'p3', label: 'P3', hint: 'low' }]
props.codeDefault: [{ value: 'all', label: 'Any priority' }, { value: 'p0', label: 'P0', hint: 'urgent' }, { value: 'p1', label: 'P1', hint: 'high' }, { value: 'p2', label: 'P2', hint: 'medium' }, { value: 'p3', label: 'P3', hint: 'low' }]

props.name: triggerWidth
props.description: Tailwind width class of the trigger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the filter; announced before the selected option.

exports.name: TaskListFilterChips
exports.description:
Owner / project chips. Only renders facets present in the data, derived
from the provider so it auto-prunes when no tasks match.

exports.name: TaskListClearFilters
exports.description: A "Clear all" button that resets search and filters; renders only while some filter is set.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the button; replaces the default styling.

exports.name: TaskListFilterOption
exports.description:
One choice of a status / priority filter. `value` is what the filter state
holds (`'all'` means no filter); `hint` is the right-aligned muted note.
Kept as task-list's own shape so callers never depend on the picker's item type.

exports.name: TaskListSavedViews
exports.description:
Saved views dropdown — captures current search + filters into a named
snapshot. Persistence is configured on `<TaskListUIProvider savedViewsStorageKey>`.

Hidden when `features.savedViews` is false.

exports.name: TaskListViewSwitcher
exports.description: A button group that switches the task list between its views (lists, flat, kanban); kanban hides when the provider's `features.kanban` is false.

props.name: views
props.description: Subset of views to render. Defaults to ['grouped','flat','kanban'].

props.name: views
props.description: Subset of views to render. Defaults to ['grouped','flat','kanban'].

exports.name: TaskListView
exports.description:
Switches between board / flat / kanban based on `useTaskListUI().view`.
Reads `filteredGroups` from the UI provider — drop in once and the
surrounding filter components update it for free.

exports.name: TaskListFlatGroups
exports.description:
Flat-list view — renders each group's filtered tasks as a section.
No drag, no kanban — used as a denser alternative to the board.

props.name: groups
props.description: The lists to show, each as a section of its tasks.

exports.name: TaskListBulkActions
exports.description:
Floating bulk-action bar visible when `selectedIds.length > 0`. Each
action calls the matching adapter mutator — the button hides if the
adapter doesn't implement it.

exports.name: TaskListPreviewSheet
exports.description:
Right-side (logical end) sheet on the overlay kit that opens when a task is
previewed. State driven by `useTaskListUI().previewId` — the connected board
sets it on row click; clicking another row while it is open swaps the task in place.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Render-prop for the footer — receives the open task. Use to drop a
"open full page" link or destructive action.

props.name: before
props.description: Append extra content above the default body.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Render-prop for the footer — receives the open task. Use to drop a
"open full page" link or destructive action.

props.name: before
props.description: Append extra content above the default body.

exports.name: TaskList
exports.description: A list of task rows with status, priority, owner and due date, subtasks, multi-select, inline rename, a row menu and optional grouping, drag and virtualization.

props.name: tasks
props.description: The top-level tasks to list, in order.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Group the rows under headers by this field; null lists them flat.

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: The selected task ids.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes (click, or Shift-click for a range), with every selected task id; rows are selectable only when this is set.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called when the user checks or unchecks a task, with the task and its new done state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Pick a specific status from the row indicator dropdown.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the user opens a task, with the task.

props.name: onRename
props.description: Inline rename: parent passes new title.

props.name: onDuplicate
props.description: Context-menu actions. Each is optional — items hide when no handler.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called when the user deletes a task from its menu, with the task.

props.name: onAddSubtask
props.description: Called when the user adds a subtask from a task's menu, with the parent task.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Expand state lifted to parent so subtask trees can persist across re-renders.

props.name: onToggleExpand
props.description: Called when the user expands or collapses a task's subtasks, with its id.

props.name: showCheckbox
props.description: Whether each row shows its done checkbox.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the list.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no tasks (default "No tasks").

props.name: listId
props.description: The list's id in the drag engine; rows drag only with this and `draggable`.

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Spoken name of the list in drag announcements; default `listId`.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether top-level rows drag from their grip (needs `listId`).

props.name: onTaskDragStart
props.description: Called when a drag starts from this list, with the task and this list's id.

props.name: onTaskDragEnd
props.description: Called when a drag that started from this list ends.

props.name: onTaskDrop
props.description: Called when a task is dropped on this list, with this list's id and the id of the task it lands before (null = the end).

props.name: virt
props.type: { /** Scroll-container height (px). */ containerHeight: number /** Row height estimate before measurement. Default 36. */ estimateRowHeight?: number /** Visible-item overscan. Default 8. */ overscan?: number }
props.description:
Virtualize the row stack — top-level tasks render through
`@tanstack/react-virtual`. Variable-height rows (subtasks expanded)
are auto-measured. Ignored when `groupBy` is set or `tasks.length`
is smaller than the container can show.
